title: Responsive Window / Item Presentation Owner Convergence
scope: 背包主視窗與既有入口、普通／不可裝備物品詳情、裝備比較、批量操作及商店商品預覽的尺寸、內容、圖像、捲動與生命週期 Owner 收斂；不修改技能、秘寶、登入或戰鬥功能。

requirements.request: 背包在可用寬高改變時保持標題、導覽與格線可用，只有既有 inventoryGridScroll 成為垂直捲動 owner。

evidence: Six normal/short viewports and in-place height reduction: title/equipment labels/footer contained; four footer controls hit-test to themselves; one inventoryGridScroll owner; six entrances and re-entry PASS.

requirements.request: 普通裝備、藥水、材料與不可裝備物品共享自適應 Medium Modal 外框，不以縮字或固定高度塞入內容。

evidence: Equipment/potion/material/chest: strict frame and ancestor containment, projected readable text >=13px, square contain art, native control hits and resize PASS; non-equipment equip disabled; chest-to-equipped restores 脫下.

requirements.request: 裝備比較在窄寬度改為上下排列，內容區單獨捲動且操作列保持可見。

evidence: Narrow comparison stacks naturally; long content scrolls; art remains square; action/back controls are contained and natively reachable without native navigation covering them.

requirements.request: 批量使用／批量開啟維持內容與行為責任，但不再影響外框尺寸；模式關閉與再次進入不殘留。

evidence: Bulk quantity and controls remain contained/reachable; legal stacked potion total 110889 exercises >100000; close/re-entry removes batch and comparison DOM. Consumption/reward settlement gameplay is unchanged; this acceptance concerns presentation and existing control reachability.

requirements.request: body 掛載的商店商品預覽以明確相容座標契約自適應，圖框維持 1:1、圖片 contain、內容單一捲動且返回按鈕可見。

evidence: Real production shop equipment artwork decodes with contain in a square frame; browser-pixel body mount remains compatible; return control and shortened-height geometry PASS.

requirements.request: 退休固定 400px／138px、potion :has 或 disabled 推測、比較視窗外框覆蓋與 runtime 尺寸注入，不以隱藏或後置覆蓋假退場。

evidence: Targeted retirement contracts and production bundle synchronization PASS on exact head and merged dev; no new frame owner, runtime size injection, wrapper, timer or observer.

requirements.request: 正式 index、feature loader、production bundle 與 360／393／412 正常及短高度 browser QA 證明最終 computed style、矩形、圖片比例、捲動、操作列及再進入清理。
